basic_info.description: Welcome to 175 Rey Street, a well-loved 1945 San Francisco gem nestled in the heart of Visitacion Valley. Owned by the same family for over 50 years, this two-bedroom plus sunroom home is brimming with character and ready for its next chapter. Inside, you'll find a spacious eat-in kitchen, hardwood floors hidden beneath the carpet, and a bright sunroom that offers flexible space for a home office or cozy retreat. The upstairs features one full bathroom, while the garage level includes a convenient 3/4 bath with additional space for room(s) expansion. 2 car tandem parking, workshop and laundry area. Step outside to a lush backyard oasis, where there are 2 kinds of blooming lemon trees, a grafted apple tree and a rosemary bush ready for you to create a serene outdoor escape. With endless possibilities to update and personalize, plus bonus space in the garage for potential growth, this is an incredible opportunity to own a classic San Francisco home.
